skeleton.source: BodyParts3D 4.0, Database Center for Life Science
skeleton.transformations: Indexed float32 glTF packing, no decimation or reflection; source coordinates and normals retained in GLB. At runtime rotate -90 degrees about X, centre uniformly and scale common assembly to maximum dimension 5.3. Isolation applies the same proper transform to a selected source component.

muscles.label: Major muscles
muscles.description: 66 named components of major skeletal muscles, preserved in their source anatomical positions. Includes bilateral muscles and separately modelled heads or regions; this is a selected collection, not every muscle.
